# secinfo

CVE, CPE, CERT-Bund and DFN-CERT catalogs.

- Toolset name: `secinfo`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 8 (8 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_get_cert_bund_advisory`

**Get CERT-Bund advisory** · read-only

Get one CERT-Bund advisory by identifier.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | SecInfo identifier, e.g. `CVE-2024-3094`, a CPE name or an advisory id |

### `openvas_get_cpe`

**Get CPE** · read-only

Get one CPE by name.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | SecInfo identifier, e.g. `CVE-2024-3094`, a CPE name or an advisory id |

### `openvas_get_cve`

**Get CVE** · read-only

Get one CVE by identifier (e.g. `CVE-2024-3094`).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | SecInfo identifier, e.g. `CVE-2024-3094`, a CPE name or an advisory id |

### `openvas_get_dfn_cert_advisory`

**Get DFN-CERT advisory** · read-only

Get one DFN-CERT advisory by identifier.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | SecInfo identifier, e.g. `CVE-2024-3094`, a CPE name or an advisory id |

### `openvas_list_cert_bund_advisories`

**List CERT-Bund advisories** · read-only

List CERT-Bund advisories from the CERT feed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |
